title: Will AI create more jobs than it destroys by 2027?
thesis: As AI spreads, India's big IT & software companies get more work — and their shares tend to rise.

best_expression.plain_label: Own a bundle of 7 AI/IT companies

plain_one_liner: Will AI create more jobs than it destroys by 2027?
plain_summary: As AI spreads, India's big IT & software companies get more work — and their shares tend to rise.
short_title: Will AI create more jobs than it destroys by 2027?

yes.summary: If AI adoption keeps lifting demand for India's IT and software firms, owning that bundle directly captures it.

no.summary: If AI doesn't clearly separate IT from the rest of the market, a concentrated bundle adds risk without a real edge — the index is the calmer default.

title: Will AI replace traditional search engines?
thesis: Newer, faster-moving Indian tech firms may do better than the giant established ones as AI reshapes the industry.
plain_one_liner: Will AI replace traditional search engines?
plain_summary: Newer, faster-moving Indian tech firms may do better than the giant established ones as AI reshapes the industry.
short_title: Will AI replace traditional search engines?

yes.summary: If AI reshapes the industry quickly, the nimble product firms should pull ahead of the slower incumbents.

no.summary: If disruption takes longer than expected, the large legacy IT firms keep their scale advantage — own them instead.

title: Will nuclear energy make a major comeback before 2027?
thesis: India's power-building boom lifts big power and engineering firms (nuclear pure-plays aren't listed here).

best_expression.plain_label: Own a bundle of 9 power & engineering firms

plain_one_liner: Will nuclear energy make a major comeback before 2027?
plain_summary: India's power-building boom lifts big power and engineering firms (nuclear pure-plays aren't listed here).
short_title: Will nuclear energy make a major comeback before 2027?

yes.summary: If India's power-building boom continues, the listed power and engineering firms benefit directly.

no.summary: Nuclear itself isn't listed here, and the wider power theme doesn't clearly separate from the market — the index is the honest fallback.

title: Will EV sales increase more than expected this year?
thesis: If electric-vehicle sales grow faster than expected, the whole EV supply chain benefits.

best_expression.plain_label: Own a bundle of 7 EV-chain companies

plain_one_liner: Will EV sales increase more than expected this year?
plain_summary: If electric-vehicle sales grow faster than expected, the whole EV supply chain benefits.
short_title: Will EV sales increase more than expected this year?

yes.summary: If EV adoption keeps accelerating, the makers, battery and parts firms in the chain benefit together.

no.summary: If EV adoption disappoints, the established petrol-engine makers and the broad index likely hold up better.

title: Will Middle-East tensions escalate further this quarter?
thesis: When conflict flares, oil and gold tend to rise, helping oil producers and defence firms.

best_expression.plain_label: Own a bundle of 6 oil & defence firms

plain_one_liner: Will Middle-East tensions escalate further this quarter?
plain_summary: When conflict flares, oil and gold tend to rise, helping oil producers and defence firms.
short_title: Will Middle-East tensions escalate further this quarter?

yes.summary: If tensions escalate, oil, gold and defence names tend to rise together — the bundle captures that.

no.summary: De-escalation doesn't reliably move oil, gold or defence stocks the other way, so there's no clean position to take if tensions cool.

title: Will Nifty touch 30,000 before year-end?
thesis: The whole Indian market would need to climb about a quarter more to reach 30,000.
plain_summary: The whole Indian market would need to climb about a quarter more to reach 30,000.

yes.summary: If the Nifty makes the roughly quarter-sized climb, owning the index or a defined-risk call spread captures the move.

no.summary: A move this large is rare — if it doesn't happen, simply holding the index avoids paying for a bet that can expire worthless.

title: Will Gold make a new all-time high this quarter?
thesis: When gold keeps hitting new highs, jewellers and gold-loan firms tend to do well.

best_expression.plain_label: Own a bundle of 4 gold-linked firms

plain_one_liner: Will Gold make a new all-time high this quarter?
plain_summary: When gold keeps hitting new highs, jewellers and gold-loan firms tend to do well.
short_title: Will Gold make a new all-time high this quarter?

yes.summary: If gold keeps printing new highs, jewellers, gold-loan financiers and gold itself tend to rise together.

no.summary: If gold stalls instead, gold-linked stocks likely just tread water — broad equity exposure is the steadier bet.

title: Will digital-payments / fintech beat the market this year?
thesis: India's digital-payment boom (UPI) may lift finance-tech companies above the market.

best_expression.plain_label: Own a bundle of 8 finance-tech firms

plain_one_liner: Will digital-payments / fintech beat the market this year?
plain_summary: India's digital-payment boom (UPI) may lift finance-tech companies above the market.
short_title: Will digital-payments / fintech beat the market this year?

yes.summary: If India's digital-payments boom keeps compounding, the listed fintech and market-infrastructure names benefit.
